lines.2: Eating on the roof might be nice.
lines.3: The breeze was cool. I could pretend I was having a picnic.
lines.4: A cool sea breeze blew past.
lines.5: The roof was quiet on any day but Tuesday. There wasn't a soul--
lines.8: In fact, she was eating lunch.
lines.9: To my surprise, Yashi had a boxed lunch.
lines.10: The presentation put the beef front and center.
lines.13: I suppose that was what came of having no friends.
lines.14: 「Why are you here, Senpai? Don't you usually eat lunch with the other idiots?」
lines.15: She sounded inconvenienced by my presence.
lines.16: 「Today's a special case. They had something to do.」
lines.17: 「Just for today, I'm eating here too.」
lines.19: The roof belonged to the school, so even Yashi couldn't quite tell me to leave.
lines.20: But the silent pressure of her 'do not approach me' barrier was in full force.
lines.21: With no other choice, I sat down a fair distance from her.
lines.22: Naturally, my lunch consisted of rice balls.
lines.23: I was used to them by now.
lines.24: Actually, I was starting to feel unsettled if I didn't have rice balls.
lines.25: 「Sorry, that was a lie. I'm forcing myself a little.」
lines.27: I realized Yashi was looking my way.
lines.30: 「Hmph. You were clever enough not to call them 'weird rice balls' when you don't know who made them.」
lines.33: Apparently, she had some unusual principles of her own.
lines.34: 「But these taste good too. There are all kinds of fillings, so I never get tired of them.」
lines.38: 「I don't know who made it, but they did an impressive job.」
lines.39: Not asking whether her mother made it was my personal rule. It would get awkward if she didn't have one.
lines.43: We talked with some distance between us.
lines.44: I squinted at the contents of her lunch.
lines.45: Shirataki noodles and onions lay over the beef.
lines.46: It was basically a beef bowl, but the side dishes--cucumber and burdock salad, plus spinach--were quite light.
lines.47: 「I can feel you staring at it rather greedily.」
lines.48: She would almost certainly refuse, but I wanted to try some.
lines.49: Beef has an irresistible pull on young men.
lines.50: 「Let me try a little of that lunch.」
lines.51: 「No. What are you saying? We are hardly that familiar.」
lines.52: She looked at me with disgust.
lines.54: 「I only asked because it really does look good.」
lines.56: Yashi apparently disliked being with me so much that she began closing her lunch box before she was finished.
lines.57: Still, I had no reason to grovel to a first-year.
lines.58: 「We are not close enough for that.」
lines.59: 「We may not be close, but we do have something in common.」
lines.63: Oh, she was mad. Definitely mad.
lines.65: Her black hair streaming behind her, Yashi walked away.
lines.67: What kind of approach would actually make her happy?
lines.69: I liked the Princess, but for some reason Yashi interested me too.
lines.70: ...Maybe I was simply weak to beautiful women.
